coordinateReferenceSystem: WGS84 longitude / latitude in degrees, EPSG:4326
authorship: School names and locations are factual reference information. Campus outlines are newly authored low-detail overview envelopes drawn from official campus maps, not copied map artwork, cadastral boundaries, surveying data, legal property extents or game collision boundaries. No official map images are redistributed.
scope: Five school markers in three metropolitan areas. Boston University includes the Charles River Campus only. Harvard depicts its Cambridge core only; Allston and Longwood are excluded. University of Maryland depicts College Park, not other University System of Maryland institutions. Penn depicts its West Philadelphia main campus, not all university-owned land.
